worldcombat.skill.firelash.summary: Kindles a burning lash and strikes a single target: physical Fire damage, and every hit lowers the target's Defense by one stage to open up the follow-up. The entangle form drags the target closer and slows it briefly and strips two stages, at the cost of power, reach and cast speed.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.use.0: Strip a foe's Defense at mid range to open up the follow-up
worldcombat.skill.firelash.use.1: Entangle form to drag a target in and follow with melee
worldcombat.skill.firelash.use.2: Keep shaving armor off a high-Defense target
worldcombat.skill.firelash.description.0: The burning lash deals %1$s physical damage; on a hit it lowers the target's Defense by %2$s stage(s) (targets immune to stat drops are unaffected), so the target takes more physical damage afterwards.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.description.1: Reach %1$s blocks; spends %2$s s kindling and stretching the lash before it cracks.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.entangle.on: Entangle form: on a hit the target is dragged up to %1$s blocks closer and slowed for %2$s (Slowness II, about 30%% slower), and loses one extra Defense stage.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.entangle.off: Lash form: a longer, heavier strike that strips one Defense stage and casts faster, but does not move the target.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.growth.0: From level %1$s the lash power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.growth.1: From level %1$s the lash power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.preference.en: On: on a hit the target is dragged 1-2 blocks closer, briefly slowed, and loses two Defense stages; costs power x0.82, reach x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks, recovery +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (lash form): a longer, heavier strike that strips one stage and casts faster.
worldcombat.skill.firelash.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the lash from farther.
On: targets whose Defense is not yet below -4 stages rank higher, spending the strip where it is still worth it; off: all targets score the same.
On: low-health targets rank higher so a lash finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
